title: Switching a website's theme cannot serve an editor document through a render that is not ready yet

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), website cluster review of #3373 and #3377.

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: publishedWebsiteSnapshot gates on the theme the snapshot was written in (WEBSITE_THEMES_LIVE is Menswork only), but since #3377 components/sites/site-page.tsx renders by readSiteStyle().theme alone, and the editor's Theme tab and Identity and branding save the site style live with no publish. A Bold site with a published Menswork snapshot that switches to Frequency immediately serves the editor document through the Frequency render, the case #3373 says must stay gated, and the share card (the hosted OG route and site-page.tsx) keys on the snapshot theme, so a Frequency site keeps the Bold card. THE FIX: gate publishedWebsiteSnapshot on the theme the site wears (siteTheme(preferences) mapped to Menswork or DAWN) as well, and key the OG route and site-page card on siteTheme. Confirm with the owner that the Frequency render of editor documents is still not ready.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!/siteTheme\(/.test(r('lib/sites/editor/state.ts'))){console.error('SCAN-831: the publish gate reads the snapshot theme, not the theme the site wears');process.exit(1)}"
